blendVariants.label: Natural
blendVariants.title: Natural Gran Corona
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Sweet coffee, cocoa, toasted almond and creamy cedar sit over a lighter, more aromatic tobacco profile than the Maduro. The Sumatra wrapper and Nicaraguan core keep the coffee infusion prominent while adding soft wood, nutty sweetness and a smooth, mellow-medium body.
blendVariants.noteHtml: The original Isla del Sol expression uses a Sumatra wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder and filler, making it the lighter, more aromatic counterpart to the darker San Andrés Maduro.

note: Nest the currently available Isla del Sol Natural Gran Corona under the existing Maduro Gran Corona as a blend variant. Correct the parent Maduro to the current in-stock Cigarworld single at A$37.39 and the verified 5 x 44 dimensions. Natural is the standard Sumatra-wrapped 5 x 44 expression, currently A$35.21 as a Cigarworld single. Preserve all unrelated parent fields.
